function.name: SAVE_FNT
function.abstract: It saves in disk a type of FNT font

description.p: This function saves in disk a type of letter in FNT format, from an identifier of the source on memory returned by functions like .

Although actually there are not facilities to change types of letter on memory from Fenix, the major utility of this function is can save in disk an archive in the new FNT format, that admits compression, from an original font in BDF or another format.

function.note: The archives created with SAVE_FNT can not be recovered from DIV Games Studio.
